raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MLX allocates each CPU request-map row for the model's full context, even when the KV pool limits requests to a much shorter length. With a 262,144-token context, 2,048 KV slots and the default 1,024 request slots, this table takes 1,025 MiB instead of about 8 MiB.

## Modifications

Bound the row width by KV capacity plus the existing decode headroom for dense and hybrid models. Model context, token capacity and concurrency limits stay unchanged. Add an initialization regression test covering both pool types and boundary cases.

## Accuracy Tests

- 29 related unit tests and eight boundary subcases pass. The new test fails before this change in two subcases.
- Default-overlap HTTP A/B: nine generation cases per model have identical output token IDs, counts and finish reasons, covering chunked prefill, concurrent requests, repeated prompts, abort recovery and invalid-input recovery.
- Dense overlap-off: seven serial cases also match.
- Hybrid overlap-on testing disables radix cache and uses 1,792/30 for the long case. The baseline stalls at 2,016/30. Dense overlap-off concurrency also fails on the baseline, so it is excluded. Hybrid overlap-off with radix fails on the baseline and was not tested after the change.

```bash
SGLANG_USE_MLX=1 PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_max_running_requests.py \
  test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_attn_dp_request_capacity.py \
  test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/mlx/test_mlx_runner_pool_contract.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Apple M2 Max 64 GB; KV capacity 2,048, chunk size 256, default concurrency limit. Idle RSS is the process-tree sum after readiness and can double-count shared pages.

| Model (4-bit) | Idle RSS MiB, before → after | Output tok/s, before → after |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Qwen3-4B, local checkpoint | 5,165.7 → 5,013.0 | 61.12 → 60.13 |
| Qwen3.5-0.8B | 4,759.6 → 3,759.8 | 212.53 → 226.26 |

Throughput uses the official serving benchmark: random token IDs, 32 requests, concurrency 4, 128 input/32 output tokens, seed 42, four warmups; medians of three sequential runs. These short runs are descriptive, rather than evidence of a general speedup.

## Checklist

- [x] Pinned pre-commit hooks: 17 applicable checks on the three changed files.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [x] Documentation: no API changes.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed results above.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

## Review and Merge Process

Repository CI still requires a maintainer's `run-ci` label.

 from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.mlx.kv_cache.auxiliary_state import (
     MlxAuxiliaryStateReqToTokenPool,
 )
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocation_sizing import get_req_to_token_extra_context_len
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator import TokenToKVPoolAllocator

 from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner import ModelRunner
@@ -284,6 +285,11 @@ def initialize(self):
         self.is_hybrid_swa = False
 
         # Create minimal pools
+        # Requests are bounded by the flat KV pool; retain decode headroom.
+        max_context_len = min(
+            self.model_config.context_len,
+            self.max_total_num_tokens + get_req_to_token_extra_context_len(),
+        )
         if mambaish_config(self.model_config) is not None:
             auxiliary_state_size = self._explicit_aux_state_size_per_worker()
             if auxiliary_state_size is None:
@@ -292,15 +298,15 @@ def initialize(self):
                 )
             self.req_to_token_pool = MlxAuxiliaryStateReqToTokenPool(
                 size=self.max_running_requests,
-                max_context_len=self.model_config.context_len,
+                max_context_len=max_context_len,
                 device="cpu",
                 enable_memory_saver=False,
                 auxiliary_state_size=auxiliary_state_size,
             )
         else:
             self.req_to_token_pool = ReqToTokenPool(
                 size=self.max_running_requests,
-                max_context_len=self.model_config.context_len,
+                max_context_len=max_context_len,
                 device="cpu",
                 enable_memory_saver=False,
             )

@@ -58,6 +58,7 @@ def _stub_for_initialize(
         max_running_requests=max_running_requests,
         max_mamba_cache_size=max_mamba_cache_size,
         disable_radix_cache=False,
+        page_size=1,
     )
     server_args = override.install()
     test.addCleanup(override.restore)

@@ -67,6 +67,7 @@ def _published(stub):
         max_running_requests=stub._max_running_requests,
         max_mamba_cache_size=stub._max_mamba_cache_size,
         disable_radix_cache=stub._disable_radix_cache,
+        page_size=1,
     )
 
 
@@ -207,6 +208,44 @@ def test_radix_disabled_uses_one_slot_per_request(self):
         )
 
 
+@unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_MLX, _SKIP_REASON)
+class TestMlxRequestMappingCapacity(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_request_mapping_does_not_reserve_unreachable_context(self):
+        """Long contexts must not reserve rows beyond KV capacity and headroom."""
+        for hybrid in (False, True):
+            for capacity, context, expected_width in (
+                (32, 128, 36),
+                (32, 34, 34),
+                (128, 32, 32),
+                (None, 64, 64),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(hybrid=hybrid, capacity=capacity, context=context):
+                    stub = _hybrid_stub_for_initialize(
+                        max_running_requests=2,
+                        max_mamba_cache_size=None,
+                        pool=capacity,
+                    )
+                    stub.model_config.context_len = context
+                    with _arch(hybrid), _published(stub):
+                        stub.initialize()
+
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        stub.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token.shape,
+                        (3, expected_width),
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(stub.model_config.context_len, context)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        stub.max_total_num_tokens,
+                        context if capacity is None else capacity,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(stub.max_running_requests, 2)
+                    if hybrid:
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            stub.req_to_token_pool.auxiliary_state_pool.size,
+                            2 * RATIO,
+                        )
+
+
 @unittest.skipUnless(_HAS_MLX, _SKIP_REASON)
 class TestMlxHybridInitializeAllocation(CustomTestCase):
     """End-to-end hybrid path: real initialize(), real aux-pool allocation."""
